question.text:
Match List I with List II and select the correct answer using the code given below the lists:
\(\begin{array}{l|l} \text{List I} & \text{List II} \\ \hline \text{(A)} f(x)=\cos x & \text{1. The graph cuts y-axis in infinite number of points} \\ \text{(B)} f(x)=\ln x & \text{2. The graph cuts x-axis in two points} \\ \text{(C)} f(x)=x^2-5 x+43. & \text{3. The graph cuts y-axis in only one point} \\ \text{(D)} f(x)=e^x & \text{4. The graph cuts x-axis in only one point} \\  & \text{5. The graph cuts x-axis in infinite number of points} \end{array}\)Codes:

solution.text:
(A) Graph of $f(x)=\cos x$ cuts $x$ -axis at infinite number of points. ( 5 of list II)

(B) Graph of $f(x)=\operatorname{In} x$ cuts $x$ -axis in only one point. (4 of list II)

(C) Graph of $f(x)=x^{2}-5 x+4$ cuts $x$ axis in two points ( 2 of list II)

(D) Graph of $\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})=\mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{x}}$ cuts $\mathrm{y}$ -axis in only one point. (3 of list II)
